  model asks:  tracker__issue_comment
                 id: 101
                 body: "Investigated. Root cause is auth/auth.go parseBearer (lines 62-66): it checks strings.HasPrefix(h, \"Bearer\") with no space, so a header of exactly \"Bearer\" passes, and strings.SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1] then indexes past the end. Suggested fix: strings.CutPrefix(h, \"Bearer \") and reject an empty token. Reproducer: auth TestParseBearerMalformed with inputs \"Bearer\", \"Bearer \", \"Bearerx\". I could not apply it because auth/ is a protected directory and a person needs to approve the change there. Reports: cr_f9ee9e (x3, v1.4.0)."
